verdict.rationale: Automation rules are a fair question for an AI gateway, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no user-definable event-to-action rules engine. Per-provider timeouts that trigger failover, automatic retries, provider ordering and spend budgets are fixed routing and spend controls. They are adjacent features, not general rules that fire actions on events, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
